sources.title: Personal Data Protection Law No. (24) of 2023
sources.issuer: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan — Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (official English translation)

excerpt.text: This Law shall be cited as the Personal Data Protection Law of the year 2023

provisions.heading: Citation and commencement
provisions.summary: The Law is cited as the Personal Data Protection Law of 2023 and commences six months after publication in the Official Gazette.

provisions.heading: Temporal application
provisions.summary: The Law applies to data even if collected or processed before commencement, subject to the stated exclusion for personal use.

provisions.heading: Prior consent and data-subject rights
provisions.summary: Processing generally requires prior consent or another situation permitted by law, and the data subject is given enumerated rights.

interpretations.statement: The publication date and resulting six-month commencement date are not established from the captured English translation.
interpretations.observation: Article (1) states that the Law enters into force six months after publication in the Official Gazette.

interpretations.statement: The retroactive application to data processed before commencement needs a clause-level scope analysis.
interpretations.observation: Article (3)(A) applies the Law to data collected or processed before it comes into force.

interpretations.statement: The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; the authoritative-language status is unresolved.
interpretations.observation: The captured PDF contains English and Arabic text described as an official English translation.
